sourceText:
Tomato and Corn Pizza
By: Erika
Published: Wednesday, May 30, 2012 - 7:22am

Ingredients




1 package pre-baked pizza crust...I used Boboli Original Pizza Crust..
3 small plum tomatoes, sliced
1/2 cup fresh corn kernels
1/2 cup of cooked sausage (optional) my family won't touch anything pizza related if there is no meat..
Salt and Pepper to taste
1/2 cup of marinara sauce.. I've tried this with pesto sauce too.. very tasty... tasty is good.
8 oz fresh mozzarella, sliced thin
2 tablespoons fresh basil leaves

Preparation

1 Preheat oven to 450 2 Place pizza crust on parchment paper lined baking sheet . 3 Stir together corn and salt and pepper. 4 Spread with marinara sauce on top of pizza crust, then top with corn mixture, tomatoes and sausage (if you decide to go the "meat please" route) 5 Then add mozzarella and basil leaves to the top of the pizza 6 Place pizza in the oven and bake for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and golden. 7 Remove from oven..

About

Garden fresh pizza, where meat is optional..
